_note: The cover of each brand: one picture filling the first screen, with these words over it. Keep the title SHORT — it is set large and centred, and a long one wraps into a wall. To change the picture, replace photos/_covers/ithos.jpg or cathelier.jpg with a landscape one and run scripts/covers.py.
_note_film: "film" plays a short silent film over the cover picture. Delete the line and the picture stays, with nothing to undo — and the picture is what shows anyway for anyone whose device is set to reduce motion or whose connection says it is metered. Changing the film itself is not a back-office job: the new recording goes in _materiais-ithos-cathelier/filmes/ and somebody runs scripts/film.sh.
